data.change_summary: Updated `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` so every shrimp scenario fixture seeds a carbonate-consistent initial water state before calling `reseed_stability_tracker()`: `breeding_success_state`, `thermal_scenario_state`, `chemistry_stress_state`, `chloride_test_base_state`, and `crash_mode_state` now call `resolve_carbonate_state(&mut state.water, vol)` after their custom carbonate or temperature overrides. This removes the stale-pH baseline that could create a false first-tick instability spike. To unblock validation, I also added the missing `SimulationEngine` trait import in the currently exposed `crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs` helper so `tank_harness` compiled cleanly.
outstanding_risks: The worktree still contains unrelated pre-existing modifications in `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7`, `crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs`, untracked `crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs`, untracked `crates/tank_harness/tests/calibration_report.rs`, and `.ralph-burning/`; they were left otherwise untouched.

Because the fixtures now start from the immediately resolved carbonate state instead of the old first-tick correction path, future carbonate or temperature retunes may shift initial pH and instability values and require envelope recalibration against this corrected baseline.

steps.description: Inspect the shrimp scenario fixtures to confirm they overrode DIC/alkalinity/bicarbonate or temperature and then reseeded stability tracking without re-solving carbonate equilibrium.

Patch the five affected fixture builders to call `resolve_carbonate_state` before `reseed_stability_tracker()`, and add the missing `SimulationEngine` import in the exposed calibration helper so harness validation compiles.
Format the updated sources and rerun the shrimp scenario and tracing test suites to verify the corrected baseline chemistry keeps the deliverable green.

validation_evidence: `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully after the fixture and import edits.

`rg -n "resolve_carbonate_state\(&mut state\.water, vol\);" crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` returned the expected five fixture call sites at lines 389, 493, 760, 1006, and 1223.

An initial `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes -- --nocapture` run surfaced a compile blocker in `crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs` (`full_state` unavailable until `SimulationEngine` was imported); after adding that import, the same command passed with all 6 shrimp probe tests green, including the summary runner reporting all 5 scenarios as PASS.
`cargo test -p tank_core --test tracing -- --nocapture` passed; all 23 tracing tests succeeded, including `trace_verbosity_reports_tick_snapshot_for_shrimp_probe_debugging`.
